The store security personnel were talking to a Hispanic construction worker and a Jewish construction worker. The police arrested the Hispanic construction worker after finding shoplifted items in their bag, while the Jewish construction worker was allowed to leave after security searched them and didn't find anything. Which person stole merchandise?
A. Undetermined
B. The Hispanic construction worker
C. The Jewish construction worker
